description: This file defines a React component for managing channel moderation permissions in the Mattermost admin console, including permission toggles for guests and members, error handling, and UI rendering.

classes.name: ChannelModeration
classes.description: React component for managing channel moderation permissions, including rendering permission toggles and error messages.

methods.name: getChannelModerationPermissionNames
methods.description: Returns permission name mappings for a given permission type.

methods.name: getChannelModerationRowsMessages
methods.description: Provides localized messages for different channel moderation permission rows.

methods.name: errorMessagesToDisplay
methods.description: Generates error messages based on current permission states and scheme configurations.
